features.name: Global Tempo Bar
features.benefit: Set BPM once (type, step, or TAP / press T) — every time-based value in the app follows live.
features.visual: cyan mono BPM numerals, ms/beat + ms/bar + Hz readouts

features.name: Tempo Detect
features.benefit: Drop any song onto the window (or click DETECT) and PulseRoom analyzes the audio offline and sets the project tempo — with a confidence rating and half-time hint.
features.visual: dashed cyan full-screen drop overlay, pulsing DETECT button while analyzing

features.name: Delay Calculator
features.benefit: Opens to the 8 essential values with usage notes; toggle reveals all 21 with straight/dotted/triplet filters; every card click-copies ms and shows the LFO Hz equivalent.
features.visual: card grid, kind pills color-coded cyan/amber/violet

features.name: Reverb Designer
features.benefit: Six spaces sized to the bar grid: pre-delay, decay, total time, plus a drawn send-EQ filter curve and wet/diffusion suggestions.
features.visual: three violet hero numbers, decay envelope SVG, send-EQ response curve with LOW CUT/HIGH CUT markers

features.name: EQ Cheat Sheet
features.benefit: 13 sources; boost (green), cut (rose), and listen (blue) zones painted on a log 20Hz-20kHz spectrum with band-by-band reasons.
features.visual: chip picker, labeled spectrum zones, two-column band cards

features.name: Compression Settings
features.benefit: 14 sources; a gain-reduction envelope shows the hit, attack window, GR depth, and release recovery beside ratio/attack/release/GR tiles.
features.visual: envelope SVG with amber attack band and green release band, 2x2 rose stat tiles

features.name: Mix Chains
features.benefit: Plugin-order recipes for 10 sources with per-step settings and a 'why this order' explanation.
features.visual: numbered nodes flowing left-to-right with arrows

features.name: Mixing Guide
features.benefit: Nine accordion sections of condensed mixing habits with hard numbers.
features.visual: accordion cards, key numbers in blue mono

features.name: Reference Tables
features.benefit: LUFS targets per platform, frequency map, psychoacoustic timing windows, note-to-Hz C0-B4.
features.visual: two-column tables with tan mono values, note-tile grid

copy.hero_subheadline: PulseRoom turns your song's BPM into delay times, reverb tails, EQ moves, and compression settings — in one beautiful desktop app that works offline.
benefits: Stay in flow — answers in two clicks, not five tabs
Learn while you mix — every number ships with its why
Works offline — no account, no ads, no spinner

feature_blocks.title: Delay, decoded.
feature_blocks.body: The eight delay values producers actually use — synced to your BPM, one click to copy. The full 21-value grid is a toggle away.

feature_blocks.title: Reverb that fits the song.
feature_blocks.body: Six spaces, pre-delay and decay locked to the bar grid, and the send-EQ curve drawn for you.

feature_blocks.title: EQ you can see.
feature_blocks.body: Boost and cut zones for 13 instruments, painted onto a real spectrum — from kick-drum sub to mix-bus air.

feature_blocks.title: Compression, finally visible.
feature_blocks.body: Watch the gain-reduction envelope for 14 sources. Attack and release stop being guesswork.

feature_blocks.title: Chains with reasons.
feature_blocks.body: Plugin order for vocals, drums, bass, and the mastering chain — each step explained.

feature_blocks.title: The reference desk.
feature_blocks.body: LUFS targets, frequency map, Haas windows, note-to-Hz for tuning 808s. Every number you Google, un-Googled.

copy.final_cta_headline: Your next session starts at your tempo.

seo.title: PulseRoom — Delay & Reverb Calculator + Mixing Toolkit for Producers (Free, Windows & Mac)
seo.description: Turn your BPM into delay times, reverb decay, EQ moves, and compression settings. PulseRoom is a free offline desktop toolkit for music producers — visual, instant, beautiful.
seo.og_title: PulseRoom — Every mixing answer. One tempo.
seo.og_description: The free desktop toolkit that syncs delay, reverb, EQ, and compression guidance to your song's BPM. Windows & macOS.
